description: The Mzizi brand system: 21 colour families (7 minerals, 7 heritage, 7 experimental), semantic colours, typography, spacing, radii and the ecosystem brands, and the Bundu floor: the minimums nothing can go under (17px body, 14px captions, 49px hit region, 7:1 body contrast, and the spacing floor (14px inset, 7px gaps between controls, 7px between a label and its field, 7px between items, 1.5 body leading)). Ask for `floors` for the floor in one call (the spacing floor is also under `accessibility`), and for `colors` to get every colour family in one call. For text, use each family's `textLight` / `textDark` on the base surface, and `onContainerLight` / `onContainerDark` on its container; never use `hex`, `lightHex` or `darkHex` as a text colour (they are accents).

family.description: One of: colors (all 21 colour families at once), floors (the Bundu floor: sizes, contrast and the spacing floor, with how it is enforced), minerals, heritage, experimental, semantic, backgrounds, typography, spacing (the scale, plus the spacing floor), radii, ecosystem, componentSpecs, accessibility, voiceAndTone, philosophy. Common aliases resolve (status/semanticColors, radius, type/fonts, exp, floor/bundu-floor/spacing-floor). Omit for everything.
